+  # variable application (ADR-0042): a bare call `name(args)` is a LOCAL call only if
+  # `name` is a top-level function, a constructor (Pascal), or a prim (`__prim_*`);
+  # otherwise `name` is a fun-valued bound variable (a param / lambda-param / bind)
+  # and the call is variable application `Var(args)`. We rewrite `CCall -> CApply`
+  # for that case here, keyed on the GLOBAL function-name set — so no per-scope
+  # tracking is needed (a bound var is never a top-level function name).
+  def nc_names(Vec(NClause)) Vec(String)
+  def nc_names([]) := []
+  def nc_names([NC(name, _, _, _) | rest]) := [name | nc_names(rest)]
+
+  def resolve_ncs(fn Vec(String), ncs Vec(NClause)) Vec(NClause)
+  def resolve_ncs(_, []) := []
+  def resolve_ncs(fn, [NC(name, pats, g, body) | rest]) := [NC(name, pats, rapp_guard(fn, g), rapp_block(fn, body)) | resolve_ncs(fn, rest)]
+
+  def is_local_call(fn Vec(String), name String) Bool := is_ctorish(name) or is_primish(name) or member_str(fn, name)
+  def is_ctorish(name String) Bool := is_upper(first_code(name))
+  def is_primish(name String) Bool := first_code(name) == 95
+  def first_code(s String) Int53
+  def first_code(s)
+    case Prim.str_chars(s) do
+      [c | _] -> c
+      [] -> 0
+    end
+  end
+  def member_str(Vec(String), String) Bool
+  def member_str([], _) := false
+  def member_str([x | rest], name) := if x == name do true else member_str(rest, name) end
+
+  def rapp(fn Vec(String), c Core) Core
+  def rapp(fn, CCall(name, args))
+    if is_local_call(fn, name) do
+      CCall(name, rapp_all(fn, args))
+    else
+      CApply(CId(name), rapp_all(fn, args))
+    end
+  end
+  def rapp(fn, CApply(c, args)) := CApply(rapp(fn, c), rapp_all(fn, args))
+  def rapp(fn, CLambda(ps, b)) := CLambda(ps, rapp(fn, b))
+  def rapp(fn, CUnary(op, x)) := CUnary(op, rapp(fn, x))
+  def rapp(fn, CBin(op, l, r)) := CBin(op, rapp(fn, l), rapp(fn, r))
+  def rapp(fn, CTuple(es)) := CTuple(rapp_all(fn, es))
+  def rapp(fn, CList(es, t)) := CList(rapp_all(fn, es), rapp_tail(fn, t))
+  def rapp(fn, CIf(c, t, e)) := CIf(rapp(fn, c), rapp_block(fn, t), rapp_block(fn, e))
+  def rapp(fn, CCase(s, arms)) := CCase(rapp(fn, s), rapp_arms(fn, arms))
+  def rapp(fn, CStruct(name, flds)) := CStruct(name, rapp_flds(fn, flds))
+  def rapp(fn, CMap(flds)) := CMap(rapp_flds(fn, flds))
+  def rapp(fn, CDot(h, f)) := CDot(rapp(fn, h), f)
+  def rapp(fn, CRemote(m, f, args)) := CRemote(m, f, rapp_all(fn, args))
+  def rapp(_, c) := c
+
+  def rapp_all(fn Vec(String), cs Vec(Core)) Vec(Core)
+  def rapp_all(_, []) := []
+  def rapp_all(fn, [c | rest]) := [rapp(fn, c) | rapp_all(fn, rest)]
+
+  def rapp_tail(fn Vec(String), t Tail) Tail
+  def rapp_tail(_, TClose) := TClose
+  def rapp_tail(fn, TTail(c)) := TTail(rapp(fn, c))
+
+  def rapp_block(fn Vec(String), b Block) Block
+  def rapp_block(fn, Block(ss)) := Block(rapp_stmts(fn, ss))
+
+  def rapp_stmts(fn Vec(String), ss Vec(Stmt)) Vec(Stmt)
+  def rapp_stmts(_, []) := []
+  def rapp_stmts(fn, [SBind(n, c) | rest]) := [SBind(n, rapp(fn, c)) | rapp_stmts(fn, rest)]
+  def rapp_stmts(fn, [STypedBind(n, t, c) | rest]) := [STypedBind(n, t, rapp(fn, c)) | rapp_stmts(fn, rest)]
+  def rapp_stmts(fn, [SExpr(c) | rest]) := [SExpr(rapp(fn, c)) | rapp_stmts(fn, rest)]
+
+  def rapp_arms(fn Vec(String), arms Vec(Arm)) Vec(Arm)
+  def rapp_arms(_, []) := []
+  def rapp_arms(fn, [Arm(p, g, b) | rest]) := [Arm(p, rapp_guard(fn, g), rapp_block(fn, b)) | rapp_arms(fn, rest)]
+
+  def rapp_guard(fn Vec(String), g Guard) Guard
+  def rapp_guard(_, GNone) := GNone
+  def rapp_guard(fn, GSome(c)) := GSome(rapp(fn, c))
+
+  def rapp_flds(fn Vec(String), flds Vec(SFld)) Vec(SFld)
+  def rapp_flds(_, []) := []
+  def rapp_flds(fn, [SFld(k, v) | rest]) := [SFld(k, rapp(fn, v)) | rapp_flds(fn, rest)]
